$comment: Risk Sentinel — recurring scholarly venues for the research themes. WIP: deadlines recur yearly and MUST be verified on the official site; this curated list is a starting calendar, not a live CFP feed. Themes: A=customs AI, B=supply-chain/maritime, C=multi-hazard/geospatial, D=LLM/XAI/accountability, E=methodology/infrastructure.

calls.name: WCO Technology Conference & Exhibition
calls.scope: Customs technology, risk management, enforcement, digital trade
calls.notes: Il venue istituzionale di riferimento per il rischio doganale; utile anche come target di dissemination ADM.

calls.name: IEEE International Conference on Big Data
calls.scope: Big data systems, applied ML, data fusion
calls.notes: Adatto per la pipeline di fusione multimodale e per i risultati applicativi sul rischio doganale.

calls.name: ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT)
calls.notes: Il riferimento per il capitolo XAI/accountability e per la validazione etica del sistema.

calls.name: World Conference on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (xAI)
calls.notes: Focus dedicato all'explainability: possibile venue per la dimensione sourceConfidence/audit trail.

calls.name: NeurIPS
calls.scope: Machine learning, LLM reasoning, datasets and benchmarks
calls.notes: Solo se il contributo è metodologico ML; altrimenti preferire venue applicativi.

calls.name: ACL / EMNLP
calls.notes: Per l'analisi documentale doganale e l'estrazione da normative/bollette.

calls.name: ISCRAM Conference
calls.scope: Information systems for crisis response and management
calls.notes: Ponte tra multi-hazard e impatto su supply chain: utile per la dimensione geophysicalImpact.

calls.name: EGU General Assembly
calls.notes: Venue per la componente climate/geophysical e per i dataset multi-hazard.

calls.name: AGU Fall Meeting
calls.scope: Earth and space sciences, hazard analytics
calls.notes: Alternativa ad EGU per la parte geofisica.

calls.name: IAME Conference (International Association of Maritime Economists)
calls.scope: Maritime economics, ports, shipping and trade
calls.notes: Riferimento per chokepoint, route criticality e impatto economico portuale.

calls.name: TRISTAN (Triennial Symposium on Transportation Analysis)
calls.notes: Per la modellazione della rete logistica e della resilienza delle rotte.

calls.name: WTO Public Forum
calls.scope: Trade policy, customs facilitation, global value chains
calls.notes: Più policy che accademico: utile per dissemination e networking istituzionale.

calls.name: Global Trade Review (GTR) events
calls.notes: Industry-facing: utile per validare i casi d'uso con operatori e ADM.
